create_uma_finetune_dataset: run the CLI script to create a UMA fine-tuning dataset from ASE atoms directories with energy or force regression tasks
create_yaml_config: create YAML configuration files for UMA fine-tuning by populating dataset paths, normalizer RMSD, and linear reference coefficients into templates
launch_processing_train: launch parallel processing of ASE atoms objects from a training directory into a structured output path using configurable workers
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data for model normalization
run_finetune_pipeline: run the full UMA fine-tune pipeline that processes train and val data, computes normalization stats, and generates YAML configs
